Commonwealth Games 2026 Medal Prospects and Schedule Discussed

Coverage from various Indian outlets discusses India's prospects at the Commonwealth Games 2026. Some reports highlight specific athletes and potential medal winners, while others analyze a potential decrease in India's medal count due to the reduction in sports events from 19 to 10. The schedule for the games, including the participation of sports like lawn bowls and the absence of wrestling, hockey, and cricket, is also a point of discussion. There is also coverage of cricket schedules for other tournaments, including the Asian Games.
